description: A project running Scrum cadence over dev-cycle delivery. Both playbooks are admitted by uses; the work-item slot is bound to dev-cycle's story and the delivery slot to dev-cycle itself; the scrum orchestrator is the root and dev-cycle's orchestrator keeps story-level states. Only this file enables automatic spawns, binds people, sets effort floors and decides which human acts need signatures.

story.description: Difference only: stories carry the two estimates the work-item slot requires. They stay under their epic; sprints hold them by membership link.
